Equipment Notice

The warehouse inspects equipment on delivery — please double-check condition when you pick up.

PMs and Technicians: confirm equipment is right for the job before you leave.

Handle equipment carefully when loading — no tipping, dropping, or tilting against the bumper. Secure units in the truck for transit.

Open packaging carefully at the jobsite and keep intact. If you find concealed damage, hold onto the packaging — discarding it can prevent a vendor return and may result in costs charged to your job.

🔄

Equipment Returns & Warranty

Damaged or wrong equipment needs to come back in original, undamaged packaging to the main warehouse dock.

Fill out the Return & Warranty Form on your device — all fields are needed so the warehouse can process it.

Warranty claims must be initiated by technicians while on the job site. It is not the responsibility of the warehouse.

DCNE returns & warranties require additional paperwork — reach out to Eddie Doucet for information.

Claim instructions document — Coming Soon

📦

Materials & Material Returns

Please include your full name and job # on sign-out sheets — incomplete sheets can't be processed.

Adding materials to a picked & staged job? Loop in your PM for approval first.

For material returns, use the Return & Warranty Request form on your device.

In the returns area, stage materials neatly and label with job # — this keeps credits accurate and gets materials back to the right place. Improves job costing and margin!

🚨

Emergency Parts

If you pull a part from an existing unit, please note: the warehouse does not handle replacement part orders or installation.

Leave a note on the unit with job #, the part taken, and the date (part # if you have it).

Create and send the warehouse the replacement part PO #.

Warehouse will notify technician and/or PM when part is received.

Heads up: units sitting longer than 60 days will be charged back to your department.
